title: Prep: sort clothes and pack the bag and lay out clothes and pick the film
notes: Sort the clothes into loads with the football kit separate. Pack the bag except the kit: boots and shin pads and water bottle. Lay out tomorrow's clothes. Stop: bag by the door and film chosen.

title: Strip the bed and put fresh sheets on and set the dirty ones aside; load 1 on (football kit goes in)
notes: Stop: bed made and machine running.

title: Cook: pork first then pasta about 30 min later then pesto stirred in off the heat
Eat and film
notes: Pause the film at 22:20. If cooking ran long the film shrinks and nothing else moves.

title: Wash up; load 1 out and hung (kit dry by tomorrow); dirty sheets in as load 2
notes: Stop: sink empty and load 2 running.

title: Clean the bathroom
notes: Toilet and sink and shower and floor. Stop: timer ends.

title: Room tidy until spotless
notes: Rubbish and cups out; clothes put away; surfaces wiped; desk reset; floor hoovered. Stop: four passes done.

title: Music and design in FL Studio
notes: Build one loop or section. Stop: timer ends and the project is saved.

title: Worship at the piano
notes: One song or set for the week; headphones if you can. Stop: timer ends and note where you stopped.

title: Week page
notes: Catch-up target and the app's next step; queue tomorrow's first video. One page no copying notes.

title: App block: choose tonight's one feature 00:00 to 00:10; build 00:10 to 00:30; write the next step 00:30 to 00:40
Text friends you're off; teeth and wash; phone on the charger; lie down at 00:50
notes: Phone across the room with the sermon queued at low volume and a sleep timer. Lights out 01:00.
